name: kvokka-harness-plugins
description: Plugins for Claude Code and Codex: one directory per plugin for both harnesses.

plugins.name: dcg
plugins.description: Every shell command of a session goes through dcg (destructive_command_guard) before it runs.

plugins.name: shell-tools
plugins.description: Tells each agent and subagent to search code with rg and ast-grep and to read JSON with toon.

plugins.name: conventional-commits
plugins.description: Tells each session to write Conventional Commit subjects, as conventional-pre-commit under prek checks them.

plugins.name: context-budget
plugins.description: Bounds the context of a session: past a soft limit the agent wraps up, past a hard limit the session stops.

plugins.name: agent-mail
plugins.description: Agents in one repository coordinate through Agent Mail: a shared thread, path reservations, and refused commits of paths another agent holds.

plugins.name: cache-warm
plugins.description: Tells each agent and subagent how long its prompt cache lives and to keep it warm while it waits.
